## Ingersoll Rand Inc. (IR) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Ingersoll Rand’s second-quarter 2026 revenue increased 8.5% year over year to approximately $2.05 billion, and adjusted EPS was $0.86 versus consensus of approximately $0.80. (company earnings materials)
- Management said at a September 17, 2026 investor conference that July trends were improving, organic orders had high-single-digit growth in the Americas, and liquidity was approximately $3.8 billion. (September 17 investor-conference presentation)
- No new September 23 company filing or contract was identified; the available September 23 coverage linked the move to the recent quarterly results and September 17 management commentary. (Quiver Quantitative)

## Thomson Reuters Corporation (TRI) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Eni S.p.A. (E) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Atlassian Corporation (TEAM) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Atlassian said on September 23, 2026 that it would pull forward by six months its submission timeline for a higher U.S. federal security authorization. (Atlassian announcement)
- Atlassian also committed to a fully disconnected, air-gapped deployment of its platform for government customers requiring network isolation. (Atlassian announcement)
- Salesforce rose 3%, Monday.com rose 3%, ServiceNow rose 2%, and the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF rose 1% during the session as enterprise-software shares moved higher. (247WallSt)

## Veeva Systems Inc. (VEEV) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Veeva announced that another top-20 biopharmaceutical company selected Vault CRM, extending the product’s reported market leadership. (Veeva company announcement)
- Veeva’s most recently reported quarter showed EPS of $2.35 versus consensus of $2.23 and revenue of $927.96 million, up 17.6% year over year. (MarketBeat)
- Andra AP-fonden reduced its Veeva position by 22.4%, selling 18,540 shares during the second quarter and retaining 64,377 shares. (SEC filing reported by MarketBeat)

## Illumina, Inc. (ILMN) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- Illumina’s second-quarter fiscal 2026 EPS was $1.31 versus consensus of $1.23. (MarketBeat)
- Second-quarter revenue was $1.16 billion, net income was $207 million, and reported profit margin was 17.86%. (Yahoo Finance data reported by Ad-hoc-news)
- UBS upgraded Illumina to Buy from its prior rating and raised its price target from $135 to $260 on September 9, 2026. (UBS analyst note reported by Yahoo Finance)

## Venture Global, Inc. (VG) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Devon Energy Corporation (DVN) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- Toms Capital, described as one of Devon Energy’s five largest shareholders, urged Devon in a letter sent earlier in September 2026 to consider strategic alternatives, including a potential sale. (Toms Capital letter reported by GuruFocus)
- Devon shares rose approximately 3% on September 23, 2026, while available coverage said there was no fresh major company announcement that day. (GuruFocus; Quiver Quantitative)
- The available analysis also cited firmer oil-market sentiment and expectations for post-merger execution following the Coterra combination. (Quiver Quantitative)

## Cadence Design Systems, Inc. (CDNS) `[Chip Equipment]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## NN, Inc. (NNBR) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- NN raised its 2026 net-sales outlook to $470 million–$490 million from $460 million–$480 million. (NN company release)
- NN raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $58 million–$68 million from $55 million–$65 million. (NN company release)
- Second-quarter revenue was $128.7 million, up 19.3% year over year, versus analyst estimates of $116.1 million. (company release reported by StockStory)
- Second-quarter adjusted EPS was $0.11 versus consensus of $0.01, and adjusted EBITDA was $17.94 million, representing a 13.9% margin. (company release reported by StockStory)
- NN said it would present at the 25th Annual D.A. Davidson Diversified Industrials & Services Conference on September 23, 2026. (NN company announcement)

## Fastly, Inc. (FSLY) `[EdgeAI]`
- D.A. Davidson raised Fastly’s price target from $21 to $23 while maintaining a Neutral rating on September 23, 2026. (D.A. Davidson note reported by MarketBeat)
- Fastly’s latest quarter showed adjusted EPS of $0.15 versus consensus of $0.07 and revenue of $183.32 million versus consensus of $173.94 million. (MarketBeat)
- No new Fastly earnings release, contract, or SEC filing was identified in the September 23 window beyond the D.A. Davidson analyst action. (MarketBeat)
